description: Pre-registered list cases for Ask's writer (ADR-0054, README.md "List cases"). Synthetic hardware-program content for one project, THERM. Research is scripted: it lists the tickets created on October 4 (the case's listed items, E1 to En), opens some of them or searches, then finishes with needs of each kind and status; only the writer is the product's model.
